2: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Lord, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
3: Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for him in God." Selah.
4: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
5: I cry to the Lord with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
6: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for the Lord sustains me.
7: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
8: Arise, Lord! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
9: Salvation belongs to the Lord. Your blessing be on your people. Selah.
